exact_meaning: Closed native service evidence under the stated event mapping; not hardware certification.
estimated_meaning: Explicit service-to-event approximation where Intel SPR documentation does not uniquely specify this simulator case.
macro_rule: OR per event; an exact positive dominates; estimated positives remain estimates; negatives require every fragment closed.

reasons.rule: One closed own L1 data hit.
One closed own L1 tag miss.
One closed own private L2 data hit.
One closed own private L2 tag miss.
One closed own LLC data hit.
One closed own LLC tag miss.
Closed L1 hit with no lower lookup or prefetch-parent evidence.
LSQ full coverage forwarding; approximate negative cache-event membership.
Resident data permission upgrade; approximate hit and miss complement.
Retired software prefetch hint included by the SPR L1_HIT definition.
Closed Sequencer follower mapped to FB or resident L1 service by its callback; no lower parent misses inherited.
Unique consumed parent outcome with matching demand attempt and completion, no generation rejection.
Unique consumed L1-begun prefetch parent outcome; FB service approximation.
Native remote supply mapped to LLC hit; hardware data-state mapping unverified.
Native merged LLC request mapped to LLC miss.
Closed macro negatives with different fragment rules, or explicit physical-split/L2 any-uop positive interpretation.
Identity-closed non-Ruby device service, no mixed RAM admissions.
Retired hint lower-event negative approximation, separate from asynchronous request accounting.
Missing, contradictory, repeated or overflowing attempt/service evidence.
Stale service or invalidated parent generation.
Conflicting parent, repeated witness or generation uniqueness rejection.
Data/ownership path attribution not closed.
Leading, ownership-crossing or warmup-spanning macro.
Functional macro membership unsupported.
